purpose: Teach: 素質/各界/度胸/議事堂/飽和/イニシアチブ/肝要/切り取っ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官の素質を見極められますね
lines.en: You have a real eye for spotting young talent on the force, don't you.
lines.style: Appreciative observation, conversational cadence. Lean forward slightly — genuinely impressed. Warm but not effusive. Landing the question mark as genuine inquiry.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、各界との連携も大事にされてますね
lines.en: And you really do take those cross-sector partnerships seriously.
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation, slightly slower pace. Soft tone — not flattery, genuine recognition. Eyes steady, nodding once. The warmth of someone who's noticed something true.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場では度胸ある判断が求められますね
lines.en: Out in the field, you have to make the tough calls without hesitation.
lines.style: Firm and direct, but not lecturing. Slight emphasis on 'have to' — acknowledging the weight of it. Steady breath. The tone of someone who understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、議事堂周辺の警備を強化されますね
lines.en: I imagine security around the Diet requires constant attention.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Pause before 'constant' — the word carrying the sense of ongoing vigilance. Warm but grounded. Not asking for reassurance, just acknowledging difficulty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、薬物市場が飽和状態にも対応されますね
lines.en: The drug trade keeps evolving, and you adapt to meet it.
lines.style: Steady recognition, slightly lower register. Not urgent — factual, clear-eyed. A note of respect for the challenge without overstating it. Calm, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯活動で地域とのイニシアチブを取られますね
lines.en: You work to build real trust with the community on crime prevention.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, deliberate pace. Land 'trust' with quiet weight — it matters. Soft eye contact. The sincerity of someone who sees what that work means.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査で肝要な手がかりを大事にされますね
lines.en: Those crucial leads in an investigation — you never let those slip.
lines.style: Approving, direct. Light emphasis on 'never' — conviction without harshness. Warm but authoritative. The tone of someone watching careful work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収資料の関係箇所を切り取って分析されますね
lines.en: You analyze the evidence methodically, piece by piece.
lines.style: Observant and precise, slower cadence. Slight emphasis on 'methodically' — respect for the rigor. Close, intimate tone — the appreciation of someone who understands detail work.
